title: First Job, CTC Breakdown & Corporate Benefits 💼
description: CTC vs In-Hand Salary, Basic, HRA, PF, Gratuity, Special Allowance, and Corporate Health Cover.

cards.title: CTC vs In-Hand Salary 📉
cards.content:
CTC (Cost to Company) ₹10 LPA hai toh bank mein ₹83,333 aayega? NO!

**Deductions**: Employee PF (12%), Professional Tax (₹200), Income Tax (TDS), Employer PF part, Medical Insurance deduction.

Actual In-Hand is usually 70-80% of CTC!
cards.imagePrompt: Salary slip graphic with pie slice highlighting take home cash

cards.title: EPF (Employee Provident Fund) 🏦
cards.content:
EPF is mandatory saving: **12% Basic Pay by employee + 12% by employer**.

Current EPF interest rate: ~8.25% p.a. (Government guaranteed, EEE tax benefit under Old/New regime).
cards.imagePrompt: Piggy bank wearing corporate tie with gold coins

choiceData.scenario: VPF (Voluntary Provident Fund) mein extra 10% opt-in karein?

choices.text: Nahi, saara liquidity in-hand cash mein chahiye

cards.title: 🚨 MISSION: Salary Slip Audit
cards.content:
🚨 **TODAY'S MISSION**

First Salary Slip Audit:

- [ ] Basic Pay identify karo (usually 40-50% of CTC).
- [ ] HRA claim calculation check (Rent receipt submission).
- [ ] UAN number & EPF portal login activate karo.
- [ ] Corporate Group Health Insurance dependents verify karo.
